audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart disagreed with the already-audited mirror in five of seven rows, and whys[6] said the late game favoured Ryze while win[6] said Yorick.
audit.why: ryze__yorick.json corrects the chart to Yorick, Skill, Skill, Skill, Skill, Ryze, Yorick. Absolute names must match on both sides; ratings are inverse.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 2, 3, 4 and 5 flipped in matched full/content pairs, with inverse ratings, and whys[6] rewritten so it agrees with its own row.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level 6 spike claimed 'Ryze has no combat ult and stays vulnerable to your cage-and-swarm at 6' as an unqualified positive.
audit.why: Realm Warp is 3000 range with a 180/160/140s cooldown and teleports him and nearby allies out after a short delay. It is not a fight button, but it is a full escape from a cage — the page treated it as if it did nothing.
audit.corrected: Six is even: Eulogy of the Isles makes it a 2v1, but Realm Warp lets him leave the fight you set up.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet defect is accurate — the matchup never named a single Ryze ability, and it described Rune Prison as a flat 'point-blank root' to be baited.
audit.why: Rune Prison only roots a target already carrying Spell Flux; without Flux it is damage plus a slow. Spell Flux and Rune Prison are both 615 range while Overload is 1000. Mourning Mist is 700, so you mark from outside both of his setup spells. Ryze has no dash in his kit, which is why Dark Procession (20/18/16/14/12s) is a genuine trap on him rather than a speed bump.
audit.corrected: Dodge Spell Flux and Rune Prison is only a slow. Mark with Mourning Mist from 700, outside his 615-range setup, then wall the retreat — he has nothing to cross it with.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns told you to bait Rune Prison with no numbers.
audit.why: Rune Prison is 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s at 615 range; the conditional root is the fact that matters.
audit.corrected: Stated the range, the cooldown and the Flux condition.

edits.before: Ryze's stacked mana and range let him poke you down and out-scale this window, favoring him.

edits.before: Ryze is weak and immobile early; your ghouls and Q out-trade his low mana pool. Step up with E to mark him and swarm before he stacks items. Punish his short root range with cage all-ins.
edits.after: Ryze is immobile and mana-starved, and Last Rites out-sustains his chip. Mourning Mist (E, 700) outranges Rune Prison and Spell Flux at 615 — mark from outside, then wall the retreat.

edits.before: Ryze has no combat ult and stays vulnerable to your cage-and-swarm at 6. Keep pressuring with ghouls and E marks while he's mana-starved. This is your strongest window to snowball.
edits.after: Realm Warp is a 3000-range reposition, not a fight button, so six does not arm him — but it does let him leave your cage. Keep pressuring with Mist Walkers and Mourning Mist while he is mana-starved.

edits.before: Raise 3-4 ghouls, E-mark Ryze so they leap, W-cage the retreat, and AA alongside the swarm — the ghouls out-damage you both.
edits.after: Raise 3-4 Mist Walkers, Mourning Mist him so they sprint in, Dark Procession his retreat, and AA alongside the swarm.

edits.after: - Rune Prison (W, 615 range, 9-11s): only roots if Spell Flux hit you first — sidestep the E and it is just a slow. - Dark Procession: 20s at rank 1, and he has no dash to cross it. - Eulogy: kill windows only, 160s at rank 1.

edits.after: Rune Prison roots only through Spell Flux — dodge the E and the W is a slow. No dash means Dark Procession holds him.
